summary: 17 upstream control modules in the root base package: Button (the pattern: gpui.Component[*X] over an inner div, RenderOnce recipe, own OnClick/TrackFocus/TabIndex), Toggle, Checkbox(+Indicator), Radio, RadioGroup, Switch(+Track/Thumb), ToggleGroup, Link, Tabs, Toolbar(+Group, roving focus), Accordion(+Item/Header/Panel/Trigger), Collapsible (MotionReveal), Avatar(+Image/Fallback), Progress(+Track/Indicator), Slider (state entity, events, parts), Pagination (pure page math + component), Table parts.

files: base/<module>.go for each of the 17 modules
base/<module>_test.go (radio_group/toggle_group tests live in radio_test.go; shared helpers in button_test.go)

tests.per_module: button 8, toggle 7, checkbox 8, radio 5, switch 9, link 7+1 dev, tabs 5, toolbar 7, accordion 3, collapsible 1, progress 3, pagination 4, table 3, slider 4, avatar 0+2 dev
deviated_list: link: TestApp records no opened URLs; asserts Link never calls App.OpenURL instead of cx.opened_url()==None
avatar x2: the core image element has no debug selector; asserts root size and fallback absence instead of reading avatar-image

orchestrator_rerun.where: git checkout-index snapshot of HEAD b0199d1 + the staged ticket-17 files (tickets 16/18 in-progress files excluded)

gap_2b_block_sites.handling: where upstream's base element is a plain div() (Block under crates.io gpui-ce 0.2.2), the constructor calls .Block() before the caller's style, so upstream layout holds and a caller's .Flex() still wins; each file's doc comment lists its sites
gap_2b_block_sites.not_affected: Button, Toggle, Tab, ToolbarGroup set flex themselves upstream

deviations: AvatarImage has no interactivity (the core image element has styling methods only)
upstream enums and Range become structs or (start,end)/(value,ok) pairs
Slider listener_for -> gpui.Window.ListenerFor; drag payloads unexported with an empty preview; drag-move not exercised by a test
Collapsible keeps one ordered child list (children and content in call order)
follow_ups: optional gpui: DebugSelector on ImgElement would let the two avatar tests port exactly
process_note: the worker split its work across three sub-agents of its own (beyond the 3-worker cap); later prompts forbid sub-agents
